title: External collaborations
description: Il nostro team è disponibile a collaborare con servizi ed enti esterni all'USI, offrendo supporto nei seguenti ambiti: Sviluppo e supporto tecnico di ambienti digitali Sviluppiamo e gestiamo ambienti digitali ad hoc per ogni esigenza (basati su Moodle, Mahara e Wordpress): p.es.

blocks.html:
Our team is available to collaborate with services and institutions outside USI, offering support and expertise in the following areas:

  • Development and technical support of digital environments
    We develop and manage ad hoc digital environments for every need (based on Moodle, Mahara and Wordpress): e.g. e-Learning platforms, portals for corporate training, websites for events or cultural initiatives, apps for research projects, etc. We also collaborate on research and experimentation projects with the development of apps, simulation environments and digital infrastructures. We can help evaluate the effectiveness of product prototypes by means of special tools such as the eye-tracking.
  • Consultancy in digital law
    The CCDigitalLaw team is available to offer specialised support on privacy issues, data management, digital licences and regulations in the field of online training and communication.
  • Workshop facilitation with LEGO® SERIOUS PLAY® methodology
    We offer ad hoc facilitation and participatory design activities with the LEGO® SERIOUS PLAY® method for working groups, teams and organisations. More information can be found on the website dedicated to our service.
  • Media in Piazza
    Media in Piazza is a permanent network that brings together organisations, associations and people active in the field of media and digital technology education in the Canton of Ticino. The initiatives - aimed at both young people and adults such as teachers, parents or educators - are designed in line with the school curriculum and aim to build contexts for reflection and shared experiences. One of the project's main partners is eLab, which participates every year in the planning of activities, teaching initiatives and in-depth discussions, contributing to research and pedagogical innovation in the field of digital education. For further information: mediainpiazza.ch.
  • Digitalisation of training courses
    We help transform your face-to-face courses into digital training paths (both synchronous and asynchronous). We offer support in the didactic transposition of content onto platforms such as Moodle or Wordpress, supporting you in structuring the course in digital format, creating eLearning modules, producing video lessons, as well as optimising accessibility and usability for users.

Contact us to evaluate collaboration opportunities together or to receive personalised advice: info@elearninglab.org.
Check out our current and past projects to find out more about our collaborations and what we do!
